name: wyvern
description: What You View, Engine Renders Natively — HTTP dialog CLI
long_description:
Pass a JSON string, .json file, or a path handled by an extension; or pipe JSON on stdin.
  See `wyvern extensions list` for the skill index.
  See `wyvern examples list` for bundled example READMEs.
  Prefix skills answer --help (example: wyvern compose render --help).
Catalog ids for `wyvern extensions show <id>` (not argv commands): markdown-suffix, html-suffix, xhtml-suffix, report-xhtml-review, report-xhtml, wizard-json-suffix, compose-render, csv-suffix, csv-table-alias, csv-md, guide
usage:
wyvern --help | -h | help
wyvern '<json>' | <file.json> | <file.md> | <page.html> | <panel.xhtml> | wizard.json [options]
echo '<json>' | wyvern [options]
wyvern browsers list|refresh
wyvern extensions list|show
wyvern examples list
wyvern wizard lint <path> [<path>...]   Static nav-button lint for wizard packages
wyvern --version
epilogue:
Extensions (see `wyvern extensions list`):
  wyvern guide                   # visual feature guide (welcome wizard)
  wyvern doc.md
  wyvern page.html
  wyvern panel.xhtml
  wyvern report-xhtml <manifest.json>  # title, optional mode, panels[{path,label,role}]
  wyvern report-xhtml --review <manifest.json>  # comments + Approve/Cancel finish
  wyvern path/to/wizard.json
  wyvern data.csv
  wyvern table data.csv          # same interactive table as data.csv
  wyvern md data.csv             # CSV as a markdown dialog
  wyvern compose render --root DIR --file FILE.j2 [--var k=v] [--var-file vars.json] [--env-prefix PREFIX]

Environment:
  WYVERN_VIEWER              Override --viewer default
  WYVERN_UI_ROOT             Override default UI root discovery
  WYVERN_SHARE               Override share/wyvern root (extensions + scripts)

Pass a JSON string, .json file, or a path handled by an extension; or pipe JSON on stdin.
  See `wyvern extensions list` for the skill index.
  See `wyvern examples list` for bundled example READMEs.
  Prefix skills answer --help (example: wyvern compose render --help).
Catalog ids for `wyvern extensions show <id>` (not argv commands): markdown-suffix, html-suffix, xhtml-suffix, report-xhtml-review, report-xhtml, wizard-json-suffix, compose-render, csv-suffix, csv-table-alias, csv-md, guide

options.name: ui-root
options.help: Packaged UI root (default: share/wyvern/ui beside binary). For .html / wizard.json, ui-root is inferred from the directory that contains wizard.json or pages/. An extension host.ui_root replaces this flag.

options.name: workflow-dry-run
options.help: Append --dry-run to wizard workflow pre/post scripts

arguments.name: input
arguments.help: JSON command string, a path handled by an extension, or omit to read JSON from stdin.

subcommands.name: wizard
subcommands.description: Lint one or more wizard packages for missing nav buttons
subcommands.long_description: lint — Lint one or more wizard packages for missing nav buttons
subcommands.usage:
wyvern wizard lint <path> [<path>...]
wyvern wizard lint --help
subcommands.epilogue:
Exit codes:
  0   All pages are clean
  1   One or more findings
  2   Usage / bad arguments

Findings codes:
  WIZARD-LINT-001  Non-entry page missing back button
  WIZARD-LINT-002  Terminal page missing cancel button
  WIZARD-LINT-003  wizard-nav.js chrome opt-in but no nav region
  WIZARD-LINT-004  Non-terminal page (with chrome opt-in) missing next button
  WIZARD-LINT-005  config.dataflow requires unsatisfied or type conflict
  WIZARD-LINT-006  Terminal post_input not covered by exports
  WIZARD-LINT-007  next_wizard input keys undeclared on target
  WIZARD-LINT-008  Local JS reads a key no page exports

See also: wyvern --help
